description: Every trading connector makes your AI more capable. Tally makes it accountable. Your AI is the analyst; Tally is the risk officer. Tally gives ChatGPT a trading journal it can operate but never rewrite: every trade starts as a pre-registered thesis with exit rules written before entry, a 24-hour cooling-off separates conviction from capital, and rule-breaking exits require a written justification that stays on the record forever. Ask for a checkup and ChatGPT briefs you on every active thesis, logs fresh evidence against your exit criteria, and flags anything that has objectively triggered. Every closed trade mints a public receipt — entry, exit, result, and your reasoning, word for word. Tally never executes trades.

defaultPrompt: Get started, then run my checkup.
I think gold breaks $5,000 by March — help me pre-register it with real invalidation criteria.
I want to take profits on my open trade — check my written rules first.
